checks: Four independent sessions; same display names still use stable userId; owner/member/admin/outsider separated
Owner mute via actual UI gives actor and target feedback, exact expiry/reason, disables text/sticker/file, preserves draft and reading
Member cannot moderate owner or inspect restrictions; outsider receives neither private notice nor reason
Manager sees correct account, reason and expiry; UI unmute removes rule, notifies target and restores existing draft
Reload restores active mute from backend; expiry automatically removes banner and enables composer without reconnect
Kick notifies removed member after access revocation, closes stale modal, returns to lobby and denies old history; kick permits rejoin
Ban denies rejoin; removed member stays in restriction list; UI unban targets correct ID and does not silently re-add membership
Ownership transfer notifies both sides; former owner immediately loses backend moderation permission
Admin UI uses explicit actions, scope and global restriction list; global mute/unmute reaches target in another room
Admin kicking current owner becomes replacement owner with immediate read/send membership; target still receives private notice
360 px dark mode has no page overflow; feedback DOM bounded; logout clears private feedback; no uncaught JS errors
